text:
No contract was formed. Costco’s catalog was an invitation to deal, so Rainmaking’s purchase order was the offer, and Costco’s confirmation made acceptance expressly conditional on a $50-per-thousand loading charge, making that writing a counteroffer under UCC §2-207(1). Rainmaking never assented to the counteroffer, and neither party performed, so the loading charge never became part of any contract.

CONFIDENCE: 88
